sources.observation: Clock faces sit in a square freestone shaft above the Swanston Street portico; its curved dome carries a narrow lantern. Bluestone piers frame the entrance arches below pale columns, balcony balustrade and the triangular pediment.

limitations: The clock tower dimensions, bell vents, balcony carving and roof heights are estimated from the exterior photograph.
